subject: Novafin - MAP draft, weekly checkpoint & updated timeline
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@novafin.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Novafin - MAP draft and next steps

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the time today. Per our discovery call, I’ve attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to align on milestones, owners, and a target close date. High-level recap:

- Goal: Replace Novafin’s in-house LLM routing for customer support with Redwood inference (hosted -> Dedicated) to reduce avg token cost and meet 99th percentile latency SLOs.
- Primary stakeholders: Samantha (Product), Tom (Security), Procurement (legal/procurement).
- Initial target: Pilot in Q2 with production rollout thereafter.

I attached Novafin-MAP-v1.xlsx — key milestones included: discovery sign-off, pilot deployment, security review, procurement/contract, and pilot launch. Responsibilities are assigned in the Owner column; please treat them as suggested and we can iterate.

Next steps I propose:
1) You and Tom review the MAP and confirm owners (due EOD Wed).
2) Procurement sends any vendor onboarding timeline and required docs (PO/license lead time).
3) We schedule a 30-min follow-up next week to walk the MAP and adjust dates.

If helpful, I can add a dependency column to capture SOC2 evidence and contract redlines — flagged in the MAP as items that will block procurement.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround on review.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: Novafin-MAP-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 sheet)

From: Samantha Lee <samantha@novafin.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Harris <tom.harris@novafin.com>, procurement@novafin.com
Date: Tue, 17 Feb 2026 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Novafin - MAP draft and next steps

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the send and the clear recap. Quick notes from our side after an initial skim of the MAP:

- The milestones look good overall. A couple of asks: can you add a clear acceptance criteria row for the pilot? We need to understand success metrics for our PMs.
- Procurement: I’m looping in procurement so they can share vendor onboarding timelines (see attached).
- Security: Tom had a couple of initial questions around SOC2 evidence and data retention — I’ve asked him to add a short list.

We’ll take a look and get back with owner confirmations by Thursday.

Appreciate it.

Samantha
Samantha Lee
Director of Product, Novafin
samantha@novafin.com

Attachment: Novafin-procurement-timeline.pdf (1 page)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@novafin.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>, Tom Harris <tom.harris@novafin.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Novafin - MAP draft and next steps

Hi Samantha / Tom —

Thanks — I’ve updated the MAP with the pilot acceptance criteria and added a Dependency column for SOC2 evidence + procurement redlines. Please find Novafin-MAP-v1.1.xlsx attached.

Proposed changes in short:
- Pilot acceptance criteria: 95% resolution within configured prompt templates; latency 99th <= 450ms; token cost <= $0.003/token for pilot.
- Target close date (contract signed): proposed March 31, 2026. Happy to move this if procurement needs more time; flagged as configurable.
- Owners: defaulted to Product for pilot success criteria, Security for SOC2 evidence, Procurement for PO/contract.

Can you confirm owners and whether the proposed March 31 target is reasonable? If procurement needs a later date, we’ll propose a revised cadence.

Also looping in Prio (Priyom) from Solutions — he’ll run the pilot plan and can scope the effort/eng hours required.

Thanks,
Marissa

Attachment: Novafin-MAP-v1.1.xlsx (spreadsheet, updated acceptance criteria)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@novafin.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Novafin - Weekly MAP checkpoint (overdue items + updated MAP attached)

Hi Samantha / Tom —

Quick weekly checkpoint — wanted to nudge on a couple of overdue items so we keep the March target in sight:

Overdue / outstanding:
- Procurement: vendor onboarding timeline (still pending)
- Security: SOC2 evidence list from Tom (requested last call)
- Owners: confirmation for Pilot PM (owner column is blank)

I’ve attached Novafin-MAP-v1.2.xlsx with the updates we discussed (added an explicit Actions column and a shaded overdue flag). Please review the updated responsibilities and the acceptance criteria row.

Can you share a status update by end of day Wednesday? If procurement needs longer, we should set a revised target close date now so our teams can plan.

If easier, happy to jump on a 15-min call tomorrow.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachment: Novafin-MAP-v1.2.xlsx (spreadsheet, MAP with status column)

From: Samantha Lee <samantha@novafin.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Harris <tom.harris@novafin.com>, procurement@novafin.com
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Novafin - Weekly MAP checkpoint (overdue items + updated MAP attached)

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the nudge and the updated MAP. Quick status:

- Procurement: vendor onboarding timeline attached; procurement estimates contract review + PO flow will push our sign-off to mid-April due to quarter-end approvals.
- Security: Tom shared SOC2 evidence request list (see attached) — he’ll gather artifacts but asked for a short lead time.
- Pilot PM owner: confirmed internally; I’ll add the name to the MAP by EOD today.
\Given procurement’s timeline, can we move the proposed contract signature to April 15, 2026? We still want to prioritize the pilot kickoff, but procurement is the gating dependency. Also, can you confirm the list of required security artifacts so Tom can coordinate with his team?
\I’ll upload the updated MAP after I add the Pilot PM owner.
\Thanks,
Samantha
\Attachment: SOC2-evidence-request.pdf (1 page)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@novafin.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Novafin - Weekly MAP checkpoint (overdue items + updated MAP attached)

Hi Samantha —

Appreciate the update and the procurement note. Confirmation: moving target contract signature to April 15, 2026 works on our side — I’ve noted that in the MAP and flagged Procurement as the dependency owner.
\Consolidated list of security artifacts we’ll provide (for Tom to coordinate):
- SOC2 Type II report (most recent)
- Data retention policy & deletion flows
- Encryption at rest/in-transit details and KMS outline
- Pen test summary (if available)
\I’ll also add an acceptance criteria sub-bullet to the MAP around SOC2 evidence delivery timelines.
\Next steps:
1) Marissa/RD team: finalize pilot plan and preliminary schedule for engineering (Prio owns scoping).
2) Samantha: update MAP with Pilot PM owner and confirm procurement dates.
3) Tom / Security: confirm list above and any additional asks.
\Let me know if you want a quick 15-min sync tomorrow — otherwise I’ll plan to check in next Tuesday.
\Best,
Marissa Cole
